maintainer_request: Track historical and ongoing Eylema token usage by model and reasoning effort, with approximate costs; direct request in the current project chat on 12 October 2026.
private_outputs: Ignored local work/usage directory; no session records or machine paths in the public PR.

acceptance.historical_usage: Scan available project session metadata and response usage; include project descendants and resumed files, deduplicate response identities, report coverage gaps.
acceptance.model_effort: Bind each response to its recorded turn context; unknown metadata stays unknown.
acceptance.cost: Date and source the official public Standard API-equivalent rates; use request-level long-context rules and cached tokens without double counting reasoning; unpriced models stay unpriced.
acceptance.persistence: Idempotent private ledger, daily/model/effort summaries and changed snapshots; future work must refresh before/after Goals and register new roots or providers.
acceptance.automation: Quiet hourly thread heartbeat refreshes local reports; no provider/account changes or spending.
acceptance.delivery: Regression tests, unchanged repository gates, actual local backfill, separate exact-commit review and current GitHub CI before authorized merge.

risks: Only available local records are measurable; deleted or other-provider histories and tool-only image/search costs are not invented.
Configured model/effort is recorded metadata, not proof of a hidden served SKU.
Subscription costs and API-equivalent estimates differ; prices are a dated valuation, not historical invoices.

roles.architect_implementer_verifier: Codex, configured gpt-6.1-sol/high in the project chat; actual usage metadata is authoritative for accounting
roles.reviewer: Pending separate context bound to final commit

repair_usage.reason: Independent review: explicit discovery failures/gaps, deferred external diagnostics, late context enrichment and truthful IO recovery.
